findings.title: Reconstruct ROI coverage instead of accepting arbitrary in-range values
findings.finding: verify_arrays reconstructs geometry and normalized_box, but coverage is checked only against[0,1]. It does not verify the deterministic3x3 point coverage, equal RGB/TIR coverage for the same box/grid, or zero descriptors when coverage is zero. In the existing central-box fixture, replacing coverage with0 or0.123 while retaining nonzero descriptors is accepted. The existing missing-coverage test itself assigns coverage0 to an ROI whose nine points remain inside the crop.
findings.reproduction: Direct CPU verify_arrays accepted impossible_zero_coverage and impossible_fractional_coverage. An in-memory complete verify_run fixture also returned CURRENT_E0_SUPPLEMENT_SMOKE_VERIFIED with coverage0.123 after updating its synthetic progress/artifact receipt. No NN execution is needed to detect this contradiction.
findings.impact: Corrupt evidence can receive the same VERIFIED status as valid evidence and change no_fully_covered_modality counts and future KEEP eligibility. A valid checksum of an internally inconsistent output does not establish ROI semantics.
findings.minimal_required_fix: Reconstruct the exact float32 points=(arange(3)+0.5)/3-0.5 and normalized-grid comparisons used by roi_descriptor, count points in[0,1) on both axes, and require both modality coverage values to equal the reconstructed fraction. Require every descriptor with coverage0 to be all zero. Preserve fractional coverage and masked descriptors for partially covered ROIs; do not zero all coverage<1 cases.
findings.focused_tests: Make the missing-coverage positive fixture use a truly uncovered normalized ROI. Reject fabricated zero/fractional coverage for a central box, unequal modality coverage, and nonzero descriptors at coverage0. Include a partial ROI and exact-boundary points using the same float32 operation order.

findings.title: Bind the verified directory to the reviewed plan run
findings.finding: verify_run reads whichever directory the caller supplies but never requires that directory to be root/plan.run. Its config, plan, receipt and native task can all describe the reviewed run while the CLI --run points at another run directory.
findings.reproduction: Copying the valid synthetic fixture's config/progress/NPZ/receipt bytes to runs/unrelated_task_output, retaining the original plan.run and native task, still returned CURRENT_E0_SUPPLEMENT_SMOKE_VERIFIED. The immutable draft run check correctly rejects changing plan.run, but it does not bind the directory argument.
findings.impact: The verifier can attribute evidence in another task's output directory to the reviewed run. Exact artifact membership and original-cache alignment do not close this output-location binding.
findings.minimal_required_fix: Before accepting outputs, require the supplied directory to equal root/plan.run under one consistent canonical path comparison. Keep the existing immutable draft, plan-file SHA, native task and artifact checks.
findings.focused_tests: A valid canonical run verifies; the identical artifact set placed under another run path is rejected.

findings.title: Bind native execution identity to actual host26 before neural work
findings.finding: The runner checks native RUNNING/pid/command/GPU but does not compare native.task to plan.task or check native.hostname against the running machine and an admitted actual26 hostname. The verifier checks native task/GPU/command but ignores native.hostname. target_host='2026' and the canonical root are literal plan metadata; the draft/audit do not carry a hostname binding.
findings.reproduction: The actual runner AST checks at lines33-37 passed a synthetic native record with WRONG_TASK and WRONG_HOST when pid/command/GPU matched. Complete synthetic verify_run returned VERIFIED with native.hostname='WRONG_HOST_2025'. This demonstrates the missing comparisons; no real wrong-host execution is claimed.
findings.impact: A native record from a different machine can satisfy postverification, and the pre-model gate does not enforce the native task identity it reads. The source review's host26 target cannot substitute for runtime host identity.
findings.minimal_required_fix: Capture the actual26 hostname in the next host audit and immutable draft. Before build_model, require native.task==plan.task and native.hostname==socket.gethostname()==plan.target_hostname; preserve pid/command/GPU checks. During CPU verification require native.hostname==plan.target_hostname along with the existing task/GPU checks. Ensure preparer carries the audit's hostname into the draft.
findings.command_consistency: Use the same canonical interpreter/script argv contract before model creation as the CPU verifier uses at lines130-133. The reviewed executable form is absolute root/conda-envs/dual_rgbt/bin/python, absolute root/scripts/collect_e0_current_supplement.py, --plan, exact config.plan_path. Merely matching a relative script path against sys.argv at startup can otherwise defer rejection until postverification.
findings.focused_tests: Reject wrong native task or hostname before model creation, reject wrong-host COMPLETE native records in verify_run, and retain positive acceptance for the exact hostname/task/command/GPU binding.

checks_without_additional_blockers.name: crop_import_and_shared_observer
checks_without_additional_blockers.assessment: Top-level import inspection found no premature dual_rgbt.tracker import on the inspected route. Runner explicitly requires Tracker to be absent before original build_model('e0'), then checks Tracker.crop_pair identity after build_tracker. One observer owns shared model.predict; control begins disabled, observed begins enabled only for sampled frames, and the record is copied before extra encodes. Tracker states and non-timing routes are compared; the original predict binding is restored and checked. There is no second observer or M1 guard.
checks_without_additional_blockers.limit: The disabled control still traverses the shared wrapper. This runner does not add a separate direct-unwrapped baseline. Its current claim should remain paired-wrapper parity plus accepted-cache box alignment, not a new full direct-unwrapped observer proof.

checks_without_additional_blockers.name: original_cache_alignment_and_no_recollection
checks_without_additional_blockers.assessment: Protected acceptance/collection/manifest/checkpoint identities and selected original NPZ digests are checked. Sampling uses actual positive in-range valid_frames[::25], compares original frame keys, verifies every prefix prediction including frame0 and preceding/current sampled boxes, and checks paired templates/history/frame/query counters. Fixed initial templates are cloned once per sequence and verified unchanged after two-modality evidence extraction. No original candidate or anchor queries are rerun.
checks_without_additional_blockers.limit: The three real NPZ files were not read by this review. Their digest and presence evidence comes from the exact host audit. Synthetic digest mismatch tests confirm the rejection logic, not those real cache contents.

checks_without_additional_blockers.name: source_input_draft_and_artifact_bindings
checks_without_additional_blockers.assessment: The exact134 map is checked at runtime, the five input hashes and selected cache hashes are rechecked, and admission binds stage/host/root/source map plus exact reviewed draft SHA. Only launch_allowed and source_review_sha256 may differ from the disabled draft. Verify_run binds config/receipt to the actual plan-file SHA and compares full artifact hashes and exact expected artifact names. These checks remain useful but do not resolve B1-B3.

checks_without_additional_blockers.name: timing_model_state_and_label_boundary
checks_without_additional_blockers.assessment: Runner specifies seed2027, cost0, disabled TF32 and frozen eval weights. Synchronized per-frame timing includes paired E0 calls, decoding, observations, state-copy checks and sampled extra evidence, with paired initialization timed and model loading excluded. Model state_dict and missing gradients are checked at completion, along with unchanged plan/source/input identities. Initial TRAIN box and accepted valid-frame schedule are used; no per-frame GT label/IoU, loss, scorer, KEEP decision or state intervention is computed.
checks_without_additional_blockers.limit: Timing is paired smoke work, not production FPS; receipt encoder counts are source-derived, not independent instrumentation. No runtime parity, speed, feature correctness or weight-immutability result was produced by this review.
